Solution B is correct: the hallway is 10 meters long.

- The robot covers 1000 m in 2.5 h = 9000 s, so its speed is 1000/9000 = 1/9 m/s ≈ 0.111 m/s.
- Over 90 s, it covers (1/9) × 90 = 10 m.

Solution A sets up the right method but makes an arithmetic error. Its conversion is (1/2.5) km/h = 0.4 km/h = 400 m/h = 400/3600 ≈ 0.111 m/s, but it rounds this to 0.1 m/s. That rounding drops about 10% of the speed and yields 9 m instead of 10 m. Solution A's answer is therefore wrong, and its method is otherwise sound.

WINNER: B
